home.title: Routines
home.subtitle: A few small tool actions that go together. Done when you do them - no streaks, no pressure.
home.emptyBody: A routine strings a few small tool actions together - a check-in, a line of gratitude, a short breath. Steps complete themselves when you use the tools.
home.starterBody: Composed from the tools already on your Home. Keep it as is, or skip - you can always build your own.

detail.stepsEmpty: No steps yet - add some in the editor.
detail.orderNote: Order is just a suggestion - do the steps in any order, or leave some for another day.
detail.deleteConfirmBody: Delete this routine and its steps? Your tool entries are untouched. This can't be undone.

form.nameRequired: Give the routine a short name.
form.saveError: Could not save the routine. Please try again.
form.stepsHelp: Each step points at a tool. It completes on days you use that tool - nothing to tick off.
form.stepsEmpty: No steps yet. Add a tool below.
